note: Version level of the compatibility canon: every declared wire-format version maps to exactly one schema $id and to at least one shared test vector. Reserved versions have no producer and no vector; adding the producer requires adding the vector in the same change.

reserved.note: present in the v1 schema's version enum as a forward reservation; no producer, no verify support, no vector

out_of_scope.note: multi-capability manifest envelope; not on the proof path, not read by wakir-verify (ADR-0072 Phase 4 scope)

runtime_emits.leaves: objects with event_id, time, payload_hash, capability_token_hash, leaf_hash

verify_reads.envelope: optional; empty string when absent (v1 manifests do not carry it)
verify_reads.hour: optional; v1 manifests carry hour_slot instead
verify_reads.leaves: objects with at least event_id and leaf_hash

field_map.constraint: wakir-verify's Manifest.envelope and Manifest.hour are empty/None for real v1 manifests; consumers read the version from raw['version'] and the hour from raw['hour_slot']. This divergence is pinned here as a known compatibility constraint, not a bug to fix in either repo without a version bump.

declared.note: container format of the shared vectors; layout documented in tests/fixtures/proof-path-vectors/README.md
